# Factions
In [textlink="Team Battle" link="WH40KGameModes"] two armies clash. Each has its own color, banner and set of [textlink="roles" link="WH40KRoles"].
## Imperium [color=#FFD200]Imperium[/color] — defenders of humanity. Color: gold, banner: guardsman.
Composition: - [color=#a4885c]Imperium[/color] (main roles): colonel, commissar, lieutenant, sergeant, guardsman, kasrkin, psyker, vox scout, chirurgeon, chaplain, astartes, Munitorum logistician, Munitorum officer, lexmechanic. - [color=#a4885c]Mechanicus[/color] (technical wing): magos, explorator, genetor, enginseer, acolyte.
Imperium command can perform [textlink="morale execution" link="WH40KMorale"] to buff the whole team.
## Heretics [color=#D62828]Heretics[/color] — Chaos cultists and traitors. Color: dark red, banner: chaos.
Composition: - [color=#a4885c]Heretics[/color] (main roles): heresiarch, champion of Chaos, chosen of Chaos, cultist, smuggler, Chaos astartes, hellish foreman. - [color=#a4885c]Dark Mechanicum[/color] (technical wing): magos-heretek, explorator, genetor, renegade tech-priest, acolyte.
Heretic officers receive [textlink="gifts of Chaos" link="WH40KPsyker"] from their patron gods: Khorne, Nurgle, Slaanesh and Tzeentch.
## Choosing a faction In the lobby and on late join you pick a faction — after that only its departments' roles are available to you. The system keeps balance: - [color=#a4885c]Soft limit[/color]: after a few rounds in a row on one faction you'll get a warning — time to switch sides. - [color=#a4885c]Hard limit[/color]: after a long streak on one faction you can't pick it again. - [color=#a4885c]Team balance[/color]: the player count gap can't be large — the system won't let everyone pile into one team.
## Race and faction Race and faction are independent but linked through roles. For example, "Imperium astartes" requires the Astartes race, while "cultist" requires a human or vulpkanin. Orks and T'au are separate races with their own roles and don't join Team Battle (available in free spawn and some modes).
